# E0804: a host example in the playground request is incomplete or inconsistent

A playground deployment registers examples of its own beside thema's, and
each must be complete and its own: an ID no other example has, a title, a
category that is not one of thema's, and a kind, when given, that names the
form its lineage is in. The examples operation lists the IDs and categories
already taken. The other examples in the request are registered regardless.

## Example

`request.json`:

```json
{"examples": [{"example": {"id": "exemplar/defaultchange", "title": "pet", "category": "Pets", "summary": "", "kind": "", "binds": true}, "lineage": {"normal": {"path": "lineage.cue", "text": "name: \"pet\"\nschemas: {\n\t\"0\": {\n\t\t\"0\": {\n\t\t\tschema: {\n\t\t\t\tname: string\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n"}}}]}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0804]: host example "exemplar/defaultchange" has the id of another example
  |
  = help: give every example an id of its own; the examples operation lists the ids already taken
```
